sentences.en: He lost his sense of direction in the dark woods.
sentences.zh: 他在黑暗的树林里迷失了方向。

sentences.en: Charles Walcot investigated the magnetic compass bearing sense in pigeons.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·沃克特研究了鸽子的磁场罗盘定向能力。

sentences.en: Your sense of humor is beginning to exert itself.
sentences.zh: 你的幽默感开始显现出来了。
